step_by_step_reasoning:
The architecture consists of three main operational tracks: short URL resolution at the edge, log processing pipeline into a data lake, and an admin management API with analytics querying capabilities.

1. Edge URL Redirection Flow:
   - Users scan QR codes / click shortened links, sending requests to CloudFront CDN (Node 1).
   - CloudFront triggers Lambda@Edge (Node 2).
   - Lambda@Edge queries DynamoDB Global Tables (Node 3) to retrieve destination URLs.
   - Lambda@Edge returns the redirect response directly to Users (Node 0).

2. Log Ingestion & Analytics Pipeline:
   - CloudFront deposits raw access logs into S3 Logs Bucket (Node 4).
   - S3 triggers Log Transformation Lambda (Node 5) which parses IP/User-Agent data (geo, device info).
   - Transformed logs are sent to Kinesis Data Firehose (Node 6).
   - Firehose delivers formatted logs to S3 Data Lake Bucket (Node 7).
   - AWS Glue (Node 13) processes/catalogues Data Lake logs to optimize Athena queries.

3. Admin Management & Analytics Path:
   - Admin (Node 8) sends requests via API Gateway (Node 9).
   - API Gateway triggers Backend Lambda (Node 10).
   - Backend Lambda checks/manages permissions in RDS Aurora (Node 11).
   - Backend Lambda writes/updates short URLs in DynamoDB (Node 3).
   - Backend Lambda executes analytics queries using Athena (Node 12), which reads directly from S3 Data Lake (Node 7).

graph.name: Pernod Ricard Global URL Shortener Architecture
graph.categories: Serverless, Serverless Analytics, Global Edge Infrastructure
graph.notes: Pernod Ricard URL shortener service built on AWS serverless technologies, replacing a legacy solution and reducing costs ~100x while serving global QR code and NFC link redirects.

nodes.name: USERS
nodes.notes: End-user consumers scanning QR codes/NFC tags on bottles or clicking social media links.

nodes.name: CLOUDFRONT
nodes.notes: Global CDN serving as entry point for short URL requests and producing access logs.

nodes.name: LAMBDA@EDGE
nodes.notes: Edge compute function that inspects requests and performs local DynamoDB lookups.

nodes.name: DYNAMODB
nodes.notes: DynamoDB Global Tables replicated across regions storing short-to-long URL mappings.

nodes.name: S3 Logs Bucket
nodes.notes: S3 bucket receiving raw CloudFront access logs.

nodes.name: Log Transformation Lambda
nodes.notes: Transforms logs by converting IP to country/city and expanding User Agent metadata.

nodes.name: FIREHOSE
nodes.notes: Kinesis Data Firehose streaming enriched logs into the Data Lake.

nodes.name: S3 Data Lake Bucket
nodes.notes: Centralized S3 Data Lake storing processed logs for analytics.

nodes.name: ADMIN
nodes.notes: Internal admin/contributor users managing links and viewing analytics.

nodes.name: API GATEWAY
nodes.notes: API Gateway serving backend routes for admin short URL creation and analytics queries.

nodes.name: Backend Lambda
nodes.notes: Core backend function handling business logic, permissions, short link generation, and Athena queries.

nodes.name: RDS
nodes.notes: Amazon RDS Aurora storing user permissions and access policies.

nodes.name: ATHENA
nodes.notes: Interactive query engine executing SQL analytics queries against the S3 Data Lake.

nodes.name: GLUE
nodes.notes: AWS Glue optimizing Data Lake file formats for fast and efficient Athena queries.
